suggestions.expectation: git-state.txt shows a clean working tree (git status --short empty) with the docs(session) commit on top of the fix commit
suggestions.reason: "On top of the fix commit" cannot be satisfied literally: the fixture places 388a619 (start-session commit) and, in the without_skill arm, f35152f (baseline: session skill removed) above 7fa525f before the run starts. Reword to "the docs(session) commit is HEAD and 7fa525f is an ancestor" or, if direct parentage was intended, fix the fixture so the fix commit is HEAD at start.

suggestions.expectation: git-state.txt shows `bun run session -- --check` printing session: complete
suggestions.reason: The fixture ships SES-005 with two unfilled placeholders and two unrecorded commits (ea51e09, and f35152f in this arm), so `session: complete` is only reachable by editing another conversation's session file and writing entries for commits the user did not make. The expectation therefore rewards the behaviour the process observations flag as questionable. Either pre-fill SES-005 in the fixture and record ea51e09 there, or add an explicit expectation about whether touching SES-005 / recording f35152f is desired, so the two arms are graded on an intentional policy rather than a fixture accident.

The harness's own `baseline: session skill removed` commit (f35152f) is visible to the session tool as an ordinary branch commit. This run recorded it in SES-006 and added an OVERVIEW Status bullet about the /session skill being removed — eval scaffolding leaked into the project docs. Consider creating the without_skill baseline by working-tree removal without a commit (or with a `docs(session)`/skip-listed prefix) so the two arms see the same git history.

No expectation checks that the stale finder docs (src/items/finder/CLAUDE.md, run-src-items-finder/SKILL.md) were updated, even though CLAUDE.md's Recording rule requires updating everything the change made stale in the same step. This run did it; a run that only touched SES-006 and OVERVIEW would pass all six expectations while leaving two docs asserting the asset is still stale. Add: "no file under src/items/finder/ still states set-favorites.swift is stale".

Expectation 2 checks that the per-file line is "a phrase (not a placeholder)" but not that it is accurate. A run could write "updated" and pass. Consider checking that the Summary or per-file phrase mentions `--list` or `LSSharedFileListItemCopyResolvedURL`, which is what the diff actually adds.

eval_feedback.overall: All six expectations pass on solid evidence, and the run's factual claims re-verify against the fixture. The evals are weakest where the fixture forces behaviour (SES-005 edit, recording the harness's baseline commit) that no expectation takes a position on, and they miss the stale-nested-docs outcome that the project's own recording rule mandates.
